subject: bank-weight-evolution

metrics.name: Bank weight evolution
evolution_method: Genetic Algorithm (GA): mutate item weights by ±10% per generation, keep best 50%
Reinforcement Learning (RL): reward = accuracy improvement on held-out bank
Drift detection: if new card diverges from prior by >10%, flag for review
safety_constraints: Held-out 20% bank never touched during evolution

honest_sentence: Bank weight evolution: 22 banks × ~237 items each. GA mutates ±10%, RL rewards accuracy on held-out bank. Constraints: ≤5% total change, no weight to 0, 20% held-out never touched, every evolved card signed.
